'''Tasbolat Mardenovich Mukhametkaliev''' (December 29, 1937, Kirovskoye District Center  [[Kazakh SSR]] – November 26, 2019,<ref name="OLENIN">{{Cite journal|last=ОЛЕНИН|first=Георгий|date=2019|title=СВЕТИТЬ ВСЕГДА, СВЕТИТЬ ВЕЗДЕ|url=https://5ea5b30d-4ecd-42be-b4dc-905fadc92142.filesusr.com/ugd/c11ddf_63c3ee70300f4d0690d6b1851324522e.pdf|journal=Современное Образование|volume=4|issue=117|pages=73–75}}</ref> [[Almaty, Kazakhstan]]) was a Kazakh scientist, teacher, author, and organizer of national higher education.<ref name="OLENIN" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://nurmedia.ru/society/4043-20-vershin-nezavisimosti-respubliki-kazahstan.html|title=20 вершин независимости Республики Казахстан|website=nurmedia.ru}}</ref> He was also a Professor and Doctor of Chemistry.<ref name="Istoriya">{{Cite web | url=https://atu.kz/main/university-of-technology/history | title=История | access-date=2020-05-06 | archive-date=2020-09-29 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200929020107/https://atu.kz/main/university-of-technology/history | url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Biography==
Tasbolat Mukhametkaliev's father was Marden Mukhametkaliev (1902–1980), the chief accountant of the Inter-village Machine and Tractor Station in the village of "[[Mukry]]". In 1949, he was appointed manager of the District Branch of the Agricultural Bank of the Kazakh SSR.

His mother was Shamkhiya (1911–1959), the daughter of a prosperous Kazakh, and she worked on a village farm.

Shamkhiya and Marden came from the [[Argyn]] clan Kanzhigaly. Together they had four children: Kayriya (1928), Tasbolat (1937),<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://nomad.su/?b=1229|title=ДНИ РОЖДЕНИЯ В КАЗАХСТАНЕ - Декабрь, 29 &#124; Номад &#124;|website=nomad.su}}</ref> Bekbolat (1941) and Zhanbolat (1944).

In 1949, Tasbolat graduated from a Kazakh elementary school, and in 1956 a Russian-language high school. He then started a chemistry program at the [[Al-Farabi Kazakh National University|S. Kirov Kazakh State University]], graduating in 1961 with a degree in [[Organic Chemistry]].<ref name="OLENIN" /> In 1967 Tasbolat defended his PhD, and in 1991 his doctoral dissertation at the Institute of Chemical Sciences at the [[Kazakhstan Academy of Sciences|Academy of Sciences of the Kazakh SSR]]. In 1993, Tasbolat received the title of Professor of Chemistry.

== Career ==
On December 1, 1964 Tasbolat began working as a Research Assistant in the department of Organic Chemistry and Chemistry of Natural Compounds of S. Kirov Kazakh State University.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://el.kz/news/archive/content-28263/|title=Мухаметкалиев Тасболат Марденович|website=el.kz|date=17 October 2013}}</ref> In 1968, he was elected as a Senior Lecturer, and in 1970 he became Assistant Professor in the Department of Organic Chemistry and Natural Compounds. From 1972 to 1987, Tasbolat worked as a Chancellor of the Dzhambul Technological Institute of Light and Food Industry.<ref>[https://tarsu.kz/index.php/histoty-of-university-1972-1987 History of the University] {{dead link|date=December 2022}}</ref>

From 1988 to 1990, Tasbolat was the Head of the Republican Government Inspection of Educational Institutions under the Ministry of Public Education of the Kazakh SSR.<ref name="auto" /> In 1995, he became Deputy Chief Scientific Secretary of the [[National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Kazakhstan]],<ref name="auto" /> Head of the Department of Planning, Expertise, and Support of Scientific Programs of the Academy of Sciences, and Head of the Department of Scientific Institutions and Scientific Personnel of the Ministry of Science and Education. From 2000 to 2009, Tasbolat worked as Vice-Chancellor for educational and methodological work, and as First Vice-Chancellor and Adviser to the Chancellor of the Almaty Technological University, before retiring in 2019.<ref name="Istoriya" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://atu.kz/en/home/university-of-technology/history|title=History|work=Almaty technological university }}</ref><ref name="auto" />

Tasbolat  authored more than 125 scientific and methodological works, manuals, and 12 copyright certificates for inventions.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.lib.ektu.kz/cgi-bin/irbis64r_15/cgiirbis_64.exe?LNG=kz&Z21ID=&I21DBN=STATU_PRINT&P21DBN=STATU&S21STN=1&S21REF=&S21FMT=fullw_print&C21COM=S&S21CNR=&S21P01=0&S21P02=1&S21P03=A=&S21STR=%D0%9C%D1%83%D1%85%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%B5%D0%B2,+%D0%A2%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B1%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%82|title=Web ІРБІС|website=www.lib.ektu.kz}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.lib.ektu.kz/cgi-bin/irbis64r_15/cgiirbis_64.exe?LNG=en&Z21ID=&I21DBN=STATU&P21DBN=STATU&S21STN=1&S21REF=5&S21FMT=fullwebr&C21COM=S&S21CNR=10&S21P01=0&S21P02=1&S21P03=A=&S21STR=%D0%9C%D1%83%D1%85%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%B5%D0%B2,+%D0%A2%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B1%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%82|title=Научная библиотека|website=www.lib.ektu.kz}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> Under his scientific supervision, 1 PhD and 6 PhD candidates were prepared.<ref name="auto" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://kaznmu.kz/rus/serzhan-esimbaevich-mombekovty-filos/|title=Сержан Есимбаевич Момбековтың философия докторы (PhD) дәрежесін ізденуге ұсынылған докторлық Диссертациялық жұмысын қорғауы өтеді|date=October 29, 2018|website=КазНМУ}}</ref>

== Recognition ==
Tasbolat was awarded by the Ministry of Education and Science of the [[Republic of Kazakhstan]] with the badges of "Excellence in Education of the Republic of Kazakhstan" and "Honorary Worker of Education of the Republic of Kazakhstan."<ref name="auto" />

On October 9, 2018, in honor of its 60-year anniversary, Dulaty University in Taraz, Kazakhstan, named its Physicochemical Research Center in Mukhametkaliev Tasbolat Mardenovich's name.<ref>[http://new1.tarsu.kz/images/doc/chemestry/dostizhenie.pdf Dulaty University] {{Dead link|date=February 2022}}</ref>

For the last decade of his life, Tasbolat became a contributing author for the periodic scientific journal ''Современное Образование'' ("Modern Education"), for which he wrote articles discussing and analyzing the system of education in Kazakhstan.<ref name="OLENIN" />

On June 12, 1965, Tasbolat married Sarah Rakhmetova. They had a son, Maksat, and a daughter, Raushan.
